rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=9, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_filter_init_std=0.05, vn_rbf_init_std=0.01, vn_lambda_init=0.02, epochs=8, batch_size=2, lr=0.00096, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=800, val_n=200, seed=42, max_train_s=1450, rationale=iter-12 (six-box). DATA lever CONFIRMED positive: iter-11 (T=4, train_n=800) hr=0.6258 vs iter-5 (T=4, train_n=400) hr=0.6174 (+0.008). Depth T=5 still dominates (iter-6 best 0.6329). COMBINE the two positive levers: T=5 + more data. ONE KNOB vs iter-6 (best): train_n 400 -> 800. HYPOTHESIS: stacking the data gain (+0.008 seen at T=4) on top of the best depth (T=5) pushes hr above iter-6's 0.6329; risk = epochs budget-squeezed under-trains at T=5+800. All else = iter-6 (T=5, f=16, k=9, n_bumps=31, x_range=2.0, lambda=0.02, lr=9.6e-4, batch=2, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). BUDGET: iter-11 (T=4,800,ep=10)=1255s; T=5 ~1.25x -> epochs=8 DEPENDENT budget var for margin (~1250s), max_train_s=1450 guards under the 1800s kill. VN plateaus early so ep=8 at 800 cases (=3200 steps) still converges (iter-11 converged at 4000 steps). batch_size=2 (OOM guard); expandable_segments via --export.
